scope: Frozen mathematical aggregation only; no real scores were read during implementation
input_contract: Each value is the already frozen per-window-then-per-sequence metric from one result.json. The future parser must bind original result fields, frozen hashes, all registered windows, scored/empty counts, and ROI before calling this kernel. No window/pixel values are accepted as independently sampled observations.

point_estimate.within_method_seed: Arithmetic mean of four sequence-level values, with equal sequence weight
point_estimate.within_method: Arithmetic mean of the three paired seed estimates
point_estimate.seed_dispersion: Sample standard deviation of the three seed estimates, numpy.std(ddof=1)

paired_ci.difference_sign: EventGenesis minus comparator; negative favors EventGenesis for AEE and outlier
paired_ci.first_average: For each sequence, average the three paired seed differences while retaining all three seeds in that cluster
paired_ci.index_generation: rng.integers(0,4,size=(10000,4)); one shared index array for every comparison and metric within each ROI call
paired_ci.interval: Two-sided percentile95% confidence interval of the resampled cluster mean

fail_closed: Any missing or extra method, seed, sequence or metric rejects the full table
Any nonnumeric, boolean or nonfinite input rejects the full table
Negative AEE/zero-flow or outlier outside[0,100] rejects the full table
Any zero-flow difference across methods or seeds rejects the full table
All four sequences are mandatory; no indoor-only final aggregate
